title: A sphere in one light
goal: Construct the form, then explain it with one consistent light source.
kit: 2H, HB, 2B, 4B, 6B; kneaded eraser; clean stump; medium-tooth paper.

steps.title: Study the reference
steps.text: Identify the highlight, halftone, core shadow, reflected light, contact dark and cast shadow. Our study is a schematic; compare it with a matte ball lit by one lamp.
steps.talk: Study the reference. Identify the highlight, halftone, core shadow, reflected light, contact dark and cast shadow. Our study is a schematic; compare it with a matte ball lit by one lamp. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Is there one consistent light direction?
steps.check: Is there one consistent light direction?

steps.title: Light block-in
steps.text: Lightly mark a square and inscribe a circle. Compare width with height using your pencil as a visual measuring aid.
steps.talk: Light block-in. Lightly mark a square and inscribe a circle. Compare width with height using your pencil as a visual measuring aid. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Is the ball round without a heavy outline?
steps.check: Is the ball round without a heavy outline?

steps.title: Refine the construction
steps.text: Place the contact point and cast-shadow ellipse. Keep the shadow on the supporting plane.
steps.talk: Refine the construction. Place the contact point and cast-shadow ellipse. Keep the shadow on the supporting plane. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Does the ball sit on the surface?
steps.check: Does the ball sit on the surface?

steps.title: Three-value map
steps.text: Group the light and shadow families. Keep reflected light within the shadow family.
steps.talk: Three-value map. Group the light and shadow families. Keep reflected light within the shadow family. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Is reflected light darker than the main lit area?
steps.check: Is reflected light darker than the main lit area?

steps.title: Five values and layers
steps.text: Layer halftones around the turning form. Deepen the core shadow and contact area; do not paint a black ring around the sphere.
steps.talk: Five values and layers. Layer halftones around the turning form. Deepen the core shadow and contact area; do not paint a black ring around the sphere. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Does the form turn gradually?

steps.title: Selective blending
steps.text: Blend across tonal transitions lightly, following the curvature. Preserve the separation between light and shadow families.
steps.talk: Selective blending. Blend across tonal transitions lightly, following the curvature. Preserve the separation between light and shadow families. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Has blending kept the core shadow?
steps.check: Has blending kept the core shadow?

steps.title: Lift the lights
steps.text: Lift a soft light on the upper-left side. A matte ball needs a broad gentle highlight rather than a sharp white dot.
steps.talk: Lift the lights. Lift a soft light on the upper-left side. A matte ball needs a broad gentle highlight rather than a sharp white dot. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Does the highlight match a matte material?
steps.check: Does the highlight match a matte material?

steps.title: Texture and detail
steps.text: Use curved strokes to restore form where blending flattened it. Avoid decorative texture on a smooth sphere.
steps.talk: Texture and detail. Use curved strokes to restore form where blending flattened it. Avoid decorative texture on a smooth sphere. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Are the marks consistent with curvature?
steps.check: Are the marks consistent with curvature?

steps.title: Final accents and edges
steps.text: Sharpen the contact dark and soften the far cast shadow. Review the sphere from a distance.
steps.talk: Final accents and edges. Sharpen the contact dark and soften the far cast shadow. Review the sphere from a distance. Pause the narration and practise on paper. Before continuing, ask yourself: Is the cast shadow firmer near the contact?
steps.check: Is the cast shadow firmer near the contact?

source: Original procedural instructional study; no external reference photograph.
drill: Repeat the study at half size without the grid. Compare your darkest dark, lightest light and largest shape before adding detail.
